description: The two plots share the same axes, with the x-axis labeled "Steps" and having a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500 in intervals of 100, and the y-axis labeled "Training Rewards" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.2 in intervals of 0.1. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set", illustrates the training rewards over steps for two models, Llama-On-Policy-Easy and Llama-LUFFY-Easy, represented by a blue line with a solid style and a red line with a solid style, respectively. Both lines start at approximately 0.0 training rewards at 0 steps, increase to around 0.15-0.18 by 200 steps, and then remain relatively steady until 500 steps, with Llama-LUFFY-Easy reaching a slightly higher value of around 0.18. The shaded regions around the lines indicate variability in the data. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set", shows a similar representation for Llama-On-Policy-Hard and Llama-LUFFY-Hard. The blue line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) starts at 0.0, increases briefly to around 0.1 by 50 steps, and then declines to nearly 0.0 by 200 steps, remaining low until 500 steps. In contrast, the red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) rises to approximately 0.1 by 100 steps and continues to fluctuate between 0.1 and 0.2 until 500 steps, where it reaches around 0.2.
